text: Every light at the Cedar Crossing fall fair goes out except the prize pumpkin display, which shines from within and hums in three-part harmony.
Drivers on County Road 9 report that the mile between marker 11 and marker 12 sometimes takes forty minutes and ends with their radios tuned to a station that apologizes politely.
A dairy farmer calls because his cows are standing in a perfect arrow formation and refusing to face anything except Orion.
The town library's microfiche reader prints star maps in the margins of old school board minutes.
